items.summary: Create a self-contained `QRCode` React component at `frontend/src/components/shared-assets/QRCode.tsx` that uses the `qr-code-styling` npm library internally. The component must accept props: `value` (string), `size` ('sm' | 'md' | 'lg', mapping to 160/256/384 px), and `options` (optional object supporting `image`, `imageOptions` ({ imageSize, margin }), `dotsOptions` ({ color }), `cornersSquareOptions` ({ color }), and `cornersDotOptions` ({ color })). It must render the styled QR code into a DOM element via `qr-code-styling`'s `append()` method, re-rendering when props change.

Update `frontend/src/pages/QrPage.tsx` to replace the current static `` QR code display with the new `` component from `@/components/shared-assets/qr-code`. Set `value` to `https://dynamic-developer-portfolio-with-public-site-and-a-w6e.caffeine.xyz/`, `size` to `"lg"`, and apply styled options with dark/accent-colored dots and corner squares consistent with the portfolio's existing color theme. Retain the existing instruction text, fallback anchor link to the portfolio URL, and noindex SEO behavior.
